Name: Arcadia Blossoms
Author: reyphorian
Description:
[size=3]Arcadia Blossoms adds 2 new trees and 8 new crops based on the flowers of the song crests from Sleep Token's album "Even In Arcadia", as well as a new type of fruit grown from one of the trees in the fall. Seeds and saplings are sold by Krobus.
[/size]

[size=4][u][b]I do not allow[/b][/u][u][b] ANY[/b][/u] of my assets to be used in any generative AI program or Language Learning Model such as Midjourney or chatGPT. [b][u][color=#ff0000]DO NOT UPLOAD TO ANY AI DATASETS.[/color]


[/u][/b][/size][size=3][u]Please reach out to me if you're interested in making a translation!

[/u]
[/size][size=3][u]Future Plans[/u]:[/size][list]
[*][size=3]Adding Vessel and the numerals as rotating antisocial NPC vendors to sell the seeds, as well as other items from future ST inspired mods[/size]
[*][size=3]Arcadia Weapons based on the weapons in the EIA song crests[/size]
[/list][size=3]
